title: 7.16.3 Sub-build: An object that draws itself
description: A Bar class with a draw(x, y) method: a grey bar, and on top of it a coloured bar scaled by value / max. Two bars from one class, each drawing itself.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The canvas is empty. `setup()` makes two bars, `health` (30 out of 30) and `magic` (4 out of 10), but nothing draws them yet.

steps.title: A draw method
steps.instructions: Inside the class, below the constructor, write a method: `draw(x, y) { ... }`. Inside it, `fill('#333');` and `rect(x, y, 200, 16);`. Then in the sketch's `draw()`, after `background(...)`, ask each bar to draw itself: `health.draw(20, 40);` and `magic.draw(20, 80);`. Run: two grey bars.
hints: A method is written inside the class with no word `function` in front of it, like `isAlive()` in the reading.
`health.draw(20, 40)` runs the method with `this` as `health`; `magic.draw(20, 80)` runs the same method with `this` as `magic`.

steps.title: How full
steps.instructions: In the method, below the grey rect, fill with the bar's own colour, `fill(this.color);`, and draw the full part on top: `rect(x, y, 200 * this.value / this.max, 16);`. Run: the green bar is full, and the blue one is less than half.
hints: 4 out of 10 is 0.4 of the bar, and 200 * 0.4 is 80 pixels.
The grey rect is drawn first, so the coloured one sits on top of it.

steps.title: The numbers
steps.instructions: At the end of the method, `text(this.value + '/' + this.max, x + 210, y + 13, 14, 'white');`. Run: 30/30 and 4/10 beside the bars. In `setup()`, change `magic.value = 4;` to `magic.value = 9;` and Run again: the blue bar grows, and the words follow it. Nothing in `draw()` had to change.

requirements.title: A draw method in the class
requirements.description: The class has a method that draws its bar with rect. Help: 7.16.2 (Reading: One class, many fighters)

requirements.title: The bar is scaled by value / max
requirements.description: The coloured bar's width is the whole width times this.value / this.max. Help: 7.16.2 (Reading: One class, many fighters)

requirements.title: Each bar draws itself
requirements.description: Both bars are drawn, each by calling its own draw method. Help: 7.16.2 (Reading: One class, many fighters)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a moSHion sketch for "Sub-build: An object that draws itself". The task: give the Bar class a draw(x, y) method that draws a grey bar 200 wide and, on top of it, a bar in this.color whose width is 200 * this.value / this.max, with the numbers beside it; then call health.draw(...) and magic.draw(...) from draw() so each bar draws itself. Accept any names, helpers, ternaries, nested ifs, switch statements and semicolons; a line only in a comment or string does not count. Short, plain notes for a 14-year-old; never write corrected code.
